Користувачі

The super-admin rules on access applications and accounts here instead of with curl and a row id. Brief #541 and amendments 1–6; code #543.

T1 · The page and its three filters

The filter is PeriodControl’s Select at 272 px in ScreenHeader’s actions slot: Заявки · Активні · Вимкнені, opening on Заявки. At 360 the slot wraps under the title, as Seasonality’s period control does. No filter carries a count. The list sits oldest first, as the route serves it. At md and up it is a table in a card (RunLog’s head: the filter’s name in caps and «Від найстаріших»): the address, «Подано», and outside Заявки «Рішення» (dd.MM.yyyy, HH:mm, Kyiv), then the actions. Below, it is the RecordCard stack. A row’s actions are Portfolio’s rowActions: outline for approve and enable, outlineDanger for decline, disable and delete, size sm, gap 2.5. The accessible name carries the address. Below md they sit in the card’s footer. Your own row is tagged «Ви» (accent-tint under ink, radius 5) and has no action; it keeps the other rows’ height. Активні is never empty, because your own row is in it. Paging: the route serves 50 rows a page with a next cursor, so past the first page the list ends with RunLog’s «Показати ще» (outline, sm, aria-disabled while it reads), which appends the next page. A ruling reads the list again from its first page.

T2 · The count on the nav

«Користувачі» stands above «Архів цін» in «Адміністрування», lucide Users (amendment 6). While applications wait, the pill carries their number at its right edge: a box 20 × 18, radius round(18 × .26) = 5, 11 px bold tabular figures, ink on sb-badge-bg. sb-badge on that tint read 3,87 in light, under SC 1.4.3, so it stays undrawn. On the folded rail and on the 360 burger, where no label is visible, the number sits at the box’s top-right corner, inside the 40 × 36 box, because the rail clips past its wall. It is 16 × 16, radius 4, 10 px bold, a card numeral on sb-indicator (Material’s large badge on a navigation item), 2 px in from the corner so its own corner stays inside the box’s r9 curve. The visible number is aria-hidden, and the link’s name carries it («Користувачі, 3»), as Primer’s CounterLabel does. With no application waiting, nothing is drawn. No route counts them, so the client reads one page of ?status=pending&limit=100: the count is its rows, and 100 rows make it «99+» (Material’s “+” suffix), so the count costs one request whatever the queue, under the list route’s throttle. It is read again with the list after every answer. The box grows with its figures, to the left on the rail and the burger; the link’s name says «Користувачі, понад 99». Below md the burger’s name carries the count too while the drawer is shut («Відкрити навігацію, заявок: 3», «…заявок: понад 99»); open, it is «Закрити навігацію» as AppHeader names it by aria-expanded, and the drawer’s link carries the count. While its first read is out or has failed, and while Заявки is empty, nothing is drawn: no zero, no mark (brief S2). A later read that fails keeps the last count. The list frames above show the panel; here are the rail and the drawer.

T3 · Empty, waiting, failed

Empty: Заявки and Вимкнені say so in RunLog’s empty line («Нових заявок немає.», «Вимкнених облікових записів немає.»). While the first read is out the list holds three rows’ boxes (HeldRows, DECISIONS’ “a list as three rows”), the wrapper aria-busy as ArchiveAdmin’s is: no spinner, nothing moves when the answer lands. A failed first read is ArchiveAdmin’s ReadCard: the key’s sentence and the key in font-mono (T5, “the list”); with no key it is the archive’s own read.status («Відповідь HTTP 429.») or read.offline («Сервер не відповів.»), and a retry. This is the archive panel’s failure exception, which #543 extends to this page.

T4 · The five confirmations

Every action confirms, on the app’s AlertDialog at 420 px in Repairs’ recipe:

  • an 18 px title naming the act;
  • a 12 px muted lead saying what happens, with the address inside the sentence in ink semibold (NN/g: “Be specific and inform users about the consequence of their action”);
  • Cancel (outline) and the action right-aligned, gap 2.5. Focus opens on Cancel (Radix’s own), except delete’s, which opens in its typed field as DeleteAccount’s does.

Approve and enable arm primary; decline and disable arm danger. Delete arms danger behind DeleteAccount’s typed field, its label the shipped «Введіть {email} для підтвердження». The button stays gated until the field matches the address. On its way the action is aria-disabled, never disabled (that would drop the focus), at opacity 70, as the archive’s buttons are; it keeps its word and its width, so Cancel never moves under the pointer. Every answer reads the list again from the start: approve gives the row a new id, decline deletes it.

T5 · Refusals: where, and a sentence for every key

Where. A refused action keeps its confirmation open. The sentence sits above the buttons as the archive’s FormRefusal draws it: 12 px text-neg with role="alert", and the key after it in font-mono. Where the answer has no key (429, or no answer) the sentence stands alone. No raw status code is drawn where a key exists. neg-tint is not used: index.css keeps it for irreversible-harm blocks, “never validation messages”. Every answer reads the list again behind the dialog, so the frames show it re-read. The action stays armed for a retry. After a disable that answers internal, «Вимкнути» is still in the open dialog though the re-read has moved the row to Вимкнені, and a second press on the now-rejected row ends its sessions again (rejectRow). A decline that answers internal may have deleted the row and left a Cognito identity no call can remove, so its sentence names the console. Where a retry would repeat the answer (self, demo, not_found, already_decided, undecided, invalid_request), the action is withdrawn and focus moves to Cancel, which closes; Radix would otherwise send it to the dialog itself. Focus stays where the press left it: on the action while it is on its way and after a refusal that keeps it armed. A later read that fails keeps what is in hand. The re-read behind a dialog says so where RunLog’s Stale does, under the card’s head and above the rows: 11 px warn-tint-text after a 12 px TriangleAlert, «Список не оновився о 14:05.» and the key in font-mono, or read.status / read.offline where the answer has no key (T3’s frame stale). «Показати ще» that fails says the same in RunLog’s line beside its button. The count’s own read has no line: it keeps the last count. A 403, any of the six gate keys, renders as the app’s not-found, by DECISIONS’ Not found and failures.

T8 · Refused, and not drawn

  • A segmented track in the header slot, or over the card (step 1, A and B), and «Заявки 3» on the filter (N1).
  • sb-badge on sb-badge-bg for the count: 3,87 in light. A bare number in sb-item (P3), or in sb-badge (P4, 4,49 in light). A dot on the rail (R2), or nothing (R3).
  • Glyphs on the row’s buttons (X2), and a row menu (X3, GitLab’s user_actions.vue): a row has two actions, so a menu adds a part and a press.
  • The address in an echo list (D2), or in the title (D3, GitLab’s “Approve user %{username}?”), which strands the “?” at 360.
  • A refusal on the row (F2): the re-read often removes the row. At the list’s head (F3): away from the act, and the disable retry would have no button.
  • A spinner for the first read, or any wait that moves when the answer lands; “Are you sure?” with no consequence; a raw status code where a key exists.
  • Керування and the banner (#548); rows declined into rejected before 6068bfe9, since no pre-v2 data is carried.
